programs.title: Secrets of The Zoo: The Wild Side
Planet of the Birds
programs.desc: A story about birds - the only animals that live on all seven continents.The creators of the program explain how they adapted to such diverse conditions.

programs.title: Wild Chile: Compilation 1
programs.desc: Chile is the longest country in the world with diverse ecosystems.The desert north and the hostile coastline to the south are home to many wild creatures.

programs.title: Europe's New Wild
programs.desc: There is no shortage of impressive metropolises and monuments of civilization on the European continent.Regions free from human interference are particularly valuable here.Past generations have witnessed the extinction of some animal species.The six-episode documentary series contains an optimistic message that nature can regenerate.The filmmakers showed the activities of scientists who are trying to rebuild fragile ecosystems in places such as the Carpathians, Lapland and the Danube Delta.In this episode they will also visit Poland.The return of the wolf, bison and lynx Viewers will learn about the effects of the program to restore the bison population in the Romanian mountains.This species plays an important role in shaping the landscape and influences the lives of other animals.The cameras captured an exciting confrontation between a herd of these majestic deer and wolves.To learn about the situation of dog ancestors, who often fell victim to humans, the documentarians went to Poland.One of the heroes of the episode is a persistent bassist.Released in the Kampinos National Park, the wolf traveled a long way alone - only in the mountains did it find a home.The filmmakers also showed the story of Slovak lynxes, which were used to rebuild the population of this species in Germany.

programs.title: Moody Beasts
programs.desc: Viewers will find answers to questions about animals.They will learn why male moose become covered in their own urine, clownfish change sex, and the brown moose dies after mating.
